//: Suber Agent Team config. Copy to suber.config.json and edit. Every field can also be set via SUBER_* env vars (env wins over file). See README.
//preset: Optional. 'orbit-anthropic' | 'orbit-openai' | 'orbit-tiered' baked in. A preset only fills defaults; anything you set below overrides it. Use a preset + just add your apiKey to get going in one line.
//provider: 'anthropic' (Messages API) or 'openai' (Chat Completions). Works with any compatible gateway, not just Orbit.
//authStyle: 'bearer' (Authorization: Bearer <key>) or 'x-api-key'. Default: bearer for openai, x-api-key for native api.anthropic.com, bearer otherwise.
//model: The default CHEAP model. Used as the fallback for any tier you do not set in `models`. Your main session model is untouched.
//models: OPTIONAL heterogeneous tiers (orchestrator-worker power move). scout=cheap breadth (fanout), worker=mid reasoning (delegate), synth=smartest (research lead + map_reduce reduce). With Orbit, ALL tiers bill to Orbit, not your main account. Omit a tier to fall back to `model`.
//maxIterationsPerAgent: Tool-loop cap per worker. 6 was too low for multi-file reads; 10 is the new default.
//synthMaxTokens: Response cap for the synth tier (decompose + reduce). Bigger by design.
//thinkingBudget: Extended-thinking budget for worker/synth tiers (anthropic only). 0 = off. e.g. 4096 to let the lead/synth plan.
//retryAttempts: Retries on 429/5xx/network (Orbit pools 429 under load). retryBaseMs = exponential backoff base.
//requestsPerMinute: Client-side rate cap so a big fan-out SELF-PACES under your provider's limits instead of 429-storming. Shared across the fleet, per base URL. 0 = off. Orbit's default limit is 60/min + 15/s, so these sit safely under it. Raise them if you raise your provider's limit; lower them for stricter gateways.
//workspaceRoot: Files the sub-agents may read/grep. Default: the directory the MCP server is launched in (your project root).
//tools: Read-only scout tools available to every sub-agent.
//capabilities: DANGEROUS. Off by default. Turning either on requires acknowledgeDangerous=true (or env SUBER_ACK_DANGEROUS=1), else it is forced off with a warning. The admin/user owns this decision.
